title: PT / PS / VS signal types
summary: PT is a target-weight signal; PS and VS are order-style signals.
narrative:
PT (Position Target) is a portfolio target-weight signal: it describes the holdings vector you want at the end of this bar. qteasy parses PT into a one-shot rebalance plan (cash_to_spend / amounts_to_sell) from current total value.

PS (Proportional Signal) is an order-style signal sized as a fraction of total assets (buys) or of current holdings (sells). It does not guarantee reaching a target weight.

VS (Value Signal) is an absolute size/amount order, closest to the matching engine.

PS and VS execute only against this bar's available cash and holdings. They do not auto-refill missing legs or spend future cash. PT may reuse same-bar sell proceeds only when shorting is off and cash_delivery_period is 0.
python_code:
import qteasy as qt
# PT / PS / VS is a Strategy / Group signal_type, not a qt.run() config key.
op = qt.Operator(strategies=['macd'], signal_type='pt')
print(op.signal_type)
risk_notes: Do not treat PS/VS as target-weight rebalance. Same-bar cash reuse is PT-only under cash_delivery_period=0.
